newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru set for court-assisted restructuring - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru set for court-assisted restructuring - paper.

text.p: Japanese restaurant operator Kyotaru Co Ltd is expected to begin its financial rehabilitation under guidance from the Tokyo District Court on Monday, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported.
The court is expected to name frozen-food producer Katokichi Co Ltd's president Yoshikazu Kato as administrator of Kyotaru's assets, the paper said in its evening edition on Saturday.
Kyotaru's business will be rebuilt with Katokichi's assistance, it said.
A court spokesman on Monday declined to comment on the report, saying confirmation would not be made until a court decision was officially announced.
Kyotaru, which operates a chain of sushi restaurants, sought protection from creditors under Japan's bankruptcy laws in January in order to restructure its operations.
A spokesman for Kyotaru said he could not confirm whether or not the court decision would be issued on Monday.
